department: Anton Pannekoek Institute for Astronomy (API), Faculty of Science

deadline.value: No fixed deadline: the 2027 recruitment is delayed, with a job ad expected in December 2026 or January 2027 and the timeline to follow.
deadline.quote: We expect to publish a job ad in December 2026 or January 2027 and this page will then be updated with the timeline for the recruitment process.

supervisor.value: You are hired for a specific funded project with its own supervisors; you cannot join first and pick a topic later.
supervisor.quote: It is not possible to join our PhD program and decide on a research topic later. | PhD level research is carried out under the supervision of two staff members

funding.value: PhD positions are salaried four-year posts funded by staff research grants.
funding.quote: Our PhD researchers are initially hired for 18 months. | You will be considered for specific PhD positions which are funded and offered by our research groups.

entry_route.value: You need or be completing a Master's (or equivalent 4+ year degree) in physics, astrophysics or similar before starting.
entry_route.quote: You have or are studying for an advanced (Masters or equivalent) degree in physics, astrophysics or a related subject.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: English: 'we do not request formal qualifications in English, we may ask for them' (no test minimum). Salary EUR 3,059-3,881 gross per month.
